svg.text: PLAN — BED AND PARTITION
SCALE 1:50 · BOTH 8 FT · SET OUT FROM THE RIGHT WALL
TV — 4 FT ½ IN
BED 6 FT × 6 FT
BED WALL · FIRST FIGURE IS THE ENTRANCE DOOR, OPEN FLAT
AT THE PARTITION LINE
BED BACK — FROM THE FOOT OF THE BED
ELEVATION · 1:25 · THE CURLS SEEN END-ON

STANDING AT THE ENTRANCE, LOOKING IN

THE PARTITION'S BACK, THE BED BEYOND
SETTING OUT
REVISION 5 · FEET AND INCHES
Both pieces moved 6 in to the right: 2 ft 11 in from the right wall to each.
Partition line: 4 ft 1⅛ in · partition 8 ft · 2 ft 11 in.
Bed wall: 3 ft 0 in open door · 1 ft 7 in clear · bed back 8 ft · 2 ft 11 in.
The bed is 6 ft 0 in × 6 ft 0 in, centred on the back, which shows 1 ft 0 in each side.
RIGHT wall to the bed: 3 ft 11 in the whole way — that wall is straight.
LEFT wall to the bed: 5 ft 1⅝ in at the foot, 5 ft 2 in at the step, 5 ft 7 in at the head —
that wall carries the splay AND the step, so the gap opens out along the bed.
The bed therefore sits off centre. Centring the 8 ft back in the 15 ft 6 in bed
wall would move everything 10 in left — but it is set off the RIGHT wall,
the only straight one, and moved 6 in right on purpose.
Walkway: curls reach 8 ft 11⅛ in, foot of the bed at 12 ft 9 in — 3 ft 9⅞ in between.
OPEN — the ledges inside the curls come to 9⅜ in × 1 ft 4½ in: a phone and a slim
lamp, not a nightstand. 9 in a side is all 8 ft leaves.
ASSUMED — back 4 ft 6 tall, ledges 2 ft. Bed and partition line measured.

g.text: 5 — the bed's clearance to each wall, splay included
